caption: The drawing depicts a puppet figure with a prominent, expressive face characterized by large, wide eyes, a black mustache, and an open mouth with visible teeth. The puppet wears a hat divided into two colors, red on one side and a muted olive green on the other. The figure is dressed in a dark, long-sleeved outfit with prominent yellow or gold trim around the edges of the sleeves, chest, and legs. The puppet's left leg is bent at the knee, and its right leg is extended straight, with a black boot on the foot. The arms are bent at the elbows with hands that have distinct fingers. The lower part of the puppet’s clothing flares out forming a circular, bag-like structure. The background is plain and unadorned. The artist's name, "FLORIAN ROKITA," is written in black in small capital letters at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Policeman Hand Puppet
